description: This file defines an interface IStreamFilter for filtering stream items and an internal class NoOpStreamFilter implementing a no-operation filter that always delivers items.

classes.name: NoOpStreamFilter
classes.description: A filter that always returns true for any stream item, effectively always delivering all items.

methods.name: ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether a stream item should be delivered based on stream ID, item, and filter data.
